summary: Independently verified all security-audit fixes (SEC-001, SEC-002, SEC-003) and hardening items (push namespacing, shop-order token, CORS). 23/23 backend tests pass. Frontend /shop loads with products and no console errors; both warenkorb.tsx and konto.tsx correctly pass ?token=<order.token> to /checkout and /payment-status. No regressions detected. Stripe 502 in preview and push provider 500/502 with placeholder key are expected per requirements.

minor.issue: Upstream returns 401 -> our code raises HTTPException(500,'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid') rather than 502. DB write happens first so security requirement (namespacing) is still fully met. Consider translating 401 to 502 for consistency with the '5xx -> 502' contract.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/backend/app/routers/push.py, treat upstream 401 as 502 (or a dedicated 'push provider not configured' 503) so the API contract 'placeholder key -> 502' is uniformly satisfied. Not blocking — security requirement (anon namespacing, real-uid binding for auth callers) is verified via DB and works regardless.
critical_code_review_comments: SEC-001 correctly gates /api/products behind roles admin/sales/customer and strips cost/salesFloor/absoluteFloor for customer, cost for sales — verified.

SEC-002 _resolve_unit_price() ignores client-supplied price; matches priority order customer_price -> contract -> standard w/ tiers. Order + generated invoice reflect server price — verified with a qty=5 order for company c1.
SEC-003 gen_reset_code() uses 8-char alphabet excluding ambiguous chars; codeHash is sha256. attempts++ per wrong code and delete_many on 5th attempt returning 429 — verified.
shop.py _authorize_shop_order() uses secrets.compare_digest for constant-time comparison — good. Legacy fallback 'if not o.get(token): return' is safe since all new orders receive a token.
push.py _caller_id() decodes JWT and rejects invalid tokens gracefully; anon fallback prefix 'anon:' prevents collision with real user ids — verified.
CORS: allow_credentials=False, allow_origins defaults to ['*'] via env — invalid wildcard+credentials combo avoided — verified via OPTIONS response headers.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed 'sec_shop_*@example.com' and their shop orders / push registrations are auto-cleaned by module teardown. Password_resets records for kunde@ss-coffee.de are deleted after each test in the SEC-003 class. No seed data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration19_security_fixes.py fully covers the audit fixes (23 tests). Reuse it as regression suite when touching products.py/orders.py/billing.py/auth.py/push.py/shop.py or CORS config. Preview STRIPE key is a placeholder — /shop/orders/{id}/checkout returns 502 when the token+auth pass. Preview EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is a placeholder — /register-push returns 500 or 502 when upstream is contacted but the DB registration is always written first, which is the actual security invariant.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — this iteration is a verification pass, not a bug fix. All 23 targeted assertions succeed against the currently deployed backend.
